name: NOVA-Safe v2 common-failure repair

development.selection: leave-one-source-out; maximize worst-source mIoU delta; within 0.05 point choose geometry before Keep-only before Keep+Drop
requirements: positive mIoU delta on every held-out source
zero newly introduced per-row IoU drops of 0.5 or more
development.router: group-bootstrap relative ridge; switch only when the fifth percentile predicted gain exceeds the locked nonnegative threshold

pilots.sampling: exact-size deterministic stratification with all queries from an audio kept in one group
pilots.promotion: both pilots must have delta_mIoU > 0 and zero newly introduced per-row IoU drops of 0.5 or more

full_evaluation.condition: only after both pilot reports pass without changing code, model, feature set, or threshold
full_evaluation.failure_action: leave all incumbent pointers and claim ledgers unchanged; preserve the rejected run as diagnostic evidence

disclosure: Both public benchmarks were observed by prior experiments. These pilots and any full rerun are iterative evidence, not pristine confirmatory tests. Pilot labels are never used to fit or tune the router that is evaluated on them.
